groups.text: It is currently 19 degrees and mostly clear in Berlin-Tempelhof.
With the morning weather set, here is the news.

OpenAI says its new flagship model, GPT-5.6 Sol, can independently optimize smaller AI models. Using a fairly underspecified prompt, Sol autonomously identified training configurations and selected GPUs to post-train the smaller Luna model. This task would have otherwise taken two staff researchers roughly two weeks to complete. On an internal benchmark for recursive self-improvement, Sol scored 16.2 points higher than its predecessor, GPT-5.5, moving the company closer to creating an automated researcher. While OpenAI focuses on software that evolves on its own, other firms are securing the physical application of autonomy. XTEND recently secured a U.S. patent for technology that allows drones to navigate toward mission objectives independently of their surrounding environment. CEO Aviv Shapira says this system translates human intent into reliable execution in hazardous or unfamiliar areas, reducing operator workload across defense and public safety applications.

A Russian airstrike on civilian infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia has left one person dead and at least 29 others injured. Regional Governor Ivan Fedorov reports that Russian forces used three guided aerial bombs to strike residential and non-residential buildings in the southeastern city. Among those wounded is at least one child. Emergency services are still responding at the scene, where authorities have begun evacuating residents from a damaged apartment building. Police spokeswoman Anna Tkachenko notes that one of the bombs remained unexploded in a residential area. Zaporizhzhia is a major industrial hub located only 20 kilometers from the battlefield, making it a frequent target for Moscow's wide range of weaponry. Governor Fedorov has urged residents to stay in safe locations and follow all instructions from emergency responders as the operation continues.

Recent SEC filings highlight shifts in beneficial ownership across two different sectors. In Santa Clara, Everpure, Inc., a company specializing in computer storage devices, filed a Form 4 on July 10. This document reports changes in securities ownership for Ajay Singh as of July 8. Meanwhile, Corvel Corp, which operates as an insurance agent and broker based in Irvine, California, submitted a Form 3 filing on the same day. That filing serves as an initial statement of beneficial ownership for Sarah A. Scott, covering the period starting July 1. While both companies are incorporated in Delaware, they operate in entirely separate industries. Everpure focuses on technology hardware, while Corvel manages financial services and insurance brokerage. These filings provide a transparent look at how insiders are positioning their holdings within these distinct corporate environments as the second half of the year begins.

Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that the AI company benefited from stolen trade secrets. In its complaint, Apple claims it uncovered a pattern of theft carried out by former Apple employees who now work for OpenAI. The lawsuit specifically names several defendants, including Chang Liu, who joined OpenAI in January, and Tang Tan, the company's chief hardware officer. Apple also names IO Products as a defendant, noting that this hardware startup was founded by Jony Ive and later acquired by OpenAI in 2025. A spokesperson for Apple told 9to5Mac that their teams are constantly developing breakthrough technologies to create the best possible products. This legal action highlights a sharp conflict over intellectual property between two of the most prominent names in technology as they compete for dominance in hardware and artificial intelligence.

Tensions remain high in the Middle East as Iran held days of public mourning for its late Supreme Leader. Fresh exchanges between Iran and the United States have cast further doubt over hopes for a lasting ceasefire. Meanwhile, NATO leaders gathered in Turkey for a pivotal summit. President Trump arrived questioning the loyalty of the alliance but left in a markedly warmer mood, while attention shifted toward his relationship with President Zelensky and future Western support for Ukraine. In France, a landmark appeal court ruling has reignited the presidential ambitions of Marine Le Pen. On the football pitch, Kylian Mbappé responded forcefully to racist abuse from a Paraguayan senator as France moved closer to a third World Cup title. Spain has now joined France in the semi-finals after defeating Belgium two to one on Friday. Mikel Merino scored late to break the Belgian resistance during the match in Los Angeles.

In Los Angeles, Kilroy Realty Corp has filed a Form 4 with the SEC to report changes in the beneficial ownership of securities. The filing, dated July 10th, identifies Justin William Smart as the reporting person for the real estate investment trust based on Olympic Boulevard. In a separate shift toward software infrastructure, the llama.cpp project released update b9957 to improve server tools and the edit tool. This release introduces a tools_io abstraction and adds tools_io_basic while removing apply_diff. The update provides broad hardware support across various platforms, including Windows x64 with CUDA 13.3 and Ubuntu arm64. It also includes compatibility for macOS Apple Silicon and Android arm64, though support for openEuler remains disabled. These technical refinements to local AI tools stand in contrast to the routine regulatory disclosures required of public real estate firms.

Apple has filed a lawsuit in California against OpenAI and two former employees, alleging the theft of trade secrets to fuel OpenAI's move into consumer hardware. The complaint targets OpenAI Foundation, OpenAI Group PBC, and io Products, claiming senior leadership directed a pattern of misconduct. Apple specifically accuses Chief Hardware Officer Tang Tan, a 24-year veteran of the company, of asking job candidates for details on unannounced products and coaching departing staff to evade security procedures. Another defendant, a former senior system electrical engineer, allegedly used an authentication bug to download confidential hardware files after failing to return a company laptop. These accusations arrive as OpenAI is rumored to be developing an AI-driven smartphone that could directly challenge the iPhone. To support these ambitions, OpenAI acquired Jony Ive’s startup, io, last year in a 6.5 billion dollar deal.
After the headlines, back to the weather.
This afternoon will be partly cloudy with temperatures between 24 and 26 degrees.
And from the weather, a quick look at the calendar.

On your calendar today: Your work calendar has Soofi Evaluation at nine in the morning, NAS Brainstorm at one in the afternoon, Nilima Exit Interview at two thirty, and beer and cocktails at five. Your personal calendar has summer holidays in Berlin all day, Bubatz delivery at six, and Höfische at seven.
And that's it for your personal morning broadcast.
[mature adult voice, intensely emotional, tender, radiant; hold a long breath after Rise] Rise... and shine.
[very very long pause before speaking; then mature adult voice, most emotional, strong, warm, radiant, deeply encouraging; hold a long breath after Rise] Rise... and shine.
